proof_body:
by
  intro f r₁ r₂ a b z h1 h12 hd hc ha hb hz1 hz2
  have h2 : 0 < r₂ := h1.trans h12
  have hl : Real.log r₁ < Real.log r₂ := Real.log_lt_log h1 h12
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, norm_zero] at hz1
    linarith
  have hzpos : 0 < ‖z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hz0
  set g : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => f (Complex.exp w) with hg
  have hmaps : ∀ w : ℂ, w ∈ Complex.re ⁻¹' Set.Icc (Real.log r₁) (Real.log r₂) → r₁ ≤ ‖Complex.exp w‖ ∧ ‖Complex.exp w‖ ≤ r₂ := by
    rintro w ⟨hw1, hw2⟩
    rw [Complex.norm_exp]
    exact ⟨by
      calc r₁ = Real.exp (Real.log r₁) := (Real.exp_log h1).symm
        _ ≤ Real.exp w.re := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hw1, by
      calc Real.exp w.re ≤ Real.exp (Real.log r₂) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hw2
        _ = r₂ := Real.exp_log h2⟩
  have hmapso : ∀ w : ℂ, w ∈ Complex.re ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (Real.log r₁) (Real.log r₂) → r₁ < ‖Complex.exp w‖ ∧ ‖Complex.exp w‖ < r₂ := by
    rintro w ⟨hw1, hw2⟩
    rw [Complex.norm_exp]
    constructor
    · calc r₁ = Real.exp (Real.log r₁) := (Real.exp_log h1).symm
        _ < Real.exp w.re := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hw1
    · calc Real.exp w.re < Real.exp (Real.log r₂) := Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hw2
        _ = r₂ := Real.exp_log h2
  have hcl : closure (Complex.re ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (Real.log r₁) (Real.log r₂)) = Complex.re ⁻¹' Set.Icc (Real.log r₁) (Real.log r₂) := by
    rw [Complex.closure_preimage_re, closure_Ioo hl.ne]
  have hgd : DiffContOnCl ℂ g (Complex.re ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (Real.log r₁) (Real.log r₂)) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro w hw
      have hw' := hmapso w hw
      have hopen : IsOpen {w : ℂ | r₁ < ‖w‖ ∧ ‖w‖ < r₂} :=
        (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).inter (isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const)
      have hfd := hd.differentiableAt (hopen.mem_nhds hw')
      exact (hfd.comp w Complex.differentiableAt_exp).differentiableWithinAt
    · rw [hcl]
      exact hc.comp Complex.continuous_exp.continuousOn hmaps
  have hcompact : IsCompact {w : ℂ | r₁ ≤ ‖w‖ ∧ ‖w‖ ≤ r₂} := by
    apply Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded
    · exact (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm).inter (isClosed_le continuous_norm continuous_const)
    · exact (Metric.isBounded_closedBall (x := (0 : ℂ)) (r := r₂)).subset (fun w hw => by simpa using hw.2)
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hcompact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hc
  have hB : BddAbove ((norm ∘ g) '' (Complex.re ⁻¹' Set.Icc (Real.log r₁) (Real.log r₂))) := by
    refine ⟨K, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact hK _ (hmaps w hw)
  set w := Complex.log z with hw
  have hexp : Complex.exp w = z := Complex.exp_log hz0
  have hre : w.re = Real.log ‖z‖ := Complex.log_re z
  have hedge1 : ∀ x : ℂ, x.re = Real.log r₁ → ‖g x‖ ≤ a := by
    intro x hx
    apply ha
    rw [Complex.norm_exp, hx, Real.exp_log h1]
  have hedge2 : ∀ x : ℂ, x.re = Real.log r₂ → ‖g x‖ ≤ b := by
    intro x hx
    apply hb
    rw [Complex.norm_exp, hx, Real.exp_log h2]
  have hmem : w ∈ Complex.re ⁻¹' Set.Icc (Real.log r₁) (Real.log r₂) := by
    constructor
    · change Real.log r₁ ≤ w.re
      rw [hre]; exact Real.log_le_log h1 hz1
    · change w.re ≤ Real.log r₂
      rw [hre]; exact Real.log_le_log hzpos hz2
  have key := Complex.HadamardThreeLines.norm_le_interp_of_mem_verticalClosedStrip' hl hmem hgd hB (fun x hx => hedge1 x hx) (fun x hx => hedge2 x hx)
  have ht : (w.re - Real.log r₁) / (Real.log r₂ - Real.log r₁) = Real.log (‖z‖ / r₁) / Real.log (r₂ / r₁) := by
    rw [hre, Real.log_div hzpos.ne' h1.ne', Real.log_div h2.ne' h1.ne']
  rw [ht] at key
  simpa [hg, hexp] using key
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r₁ r₂ a b : ℝ) (z : ℂ), 0 < r₁ → r₁ < r₂ → DifferentiableOn ℂ f {w : ℂ | r₁ < ‖w‖ ∧ ‖w‖ < r₂} → ContinuousOn f {w : ℂ | r₁ ≤ ‖w‖ ∧ ‖w‖ ≤ r₂} → (∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ = r₁ → ‖f w‖ ≤ a) → (∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ = r₂ → ‖f w‖ ≤ b) → r₁ ≤ ‖z‖ → ‖z‖ ≤ r₂ → ‖f z‖ ≤ a ^ (1 - Real.log (‖z‖ / r₁) / Real.log (r₂ / r₁)) * b ^ (Real.log (‖z‖ / r₁) / Real.log (r₂ / r₁))
